invoice.instructions: Output every printed table row, even when stamped over or when consecutive rows repeat the same code, description, and price. Never skip or merge rows. Start a new section whenever a printed section header row appears in the table. Use null for section_name only for rows at the top of a continuation page before the first section header on that page. Return null for any field not printed on the page (such as stay.admission_date and stay.discharge_date on single-visit receipts, or description/english_description when only one language is printed). Put the Arabic service name in description and the English service name in english_description; never swap or duplicate them across both fields. Do not invent section names not printed in the table and do not output empty sections.

receipt.receipt_number: verbatim-string. The digits printed after إيصال رقم. Copy them. Do not return null.

outpatient_invoice.instructions: Return null for any field not printed on the invoice (such as hospital_name when no letterhead is printed, company, employee_number, relationship, stay, section_name, item date and time, or description when only an English drug name is printed). Never copy the unit column (such as Strip, Bottle, Ampul, شريط, قطعة) into english_description, and never copy a hospital name from examples when it is not printed on the page. Put Arabic text in description and English text in english_description without duplicating the same string in both. Output every printed table row and never skip or merge rows.
